name: Inner Growth
source:
In this game you will follow around our protagonist Thalna, who spent most of her time in the underworld and because of some implications is now forced to go to the human realm.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/MorallyPurple]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将跟随我们的主角塔尔娜（Thalna），她大部分时间都在地下世界度过，由于某些影响现在被迫前往人类领域。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/MorallyPurple]Patreon[/url]]
